request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Prismhorn Ram".

Creative brief
Name: Prismhorn Ram
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A charging refractor that splits one projectile lane into several colored branches.
Body and silhouette: Thick-bodied ram with curled crystalline horns, sturdy legs, and a lowered armored head.
Signature features: Transparent prism horns, glowing forehead rune, and faceted shoulder wool.
Palette and materials: Cream, deep violet, pale cyan, and muted rainbow reflections.
Movement personality: Proud, forceful, and geometrically precise.
Attack concept: Fires a single bright bolt between its horns; after reaching a marked point, the bolt divides into three evenly angled rays.
Directional details: The left horn has a chipped outer tip.
Avoid: Rainbow mascot, ordinary farm sheep, excessive transparent detail.
